mic.priming: Your phone will ask to use the microphone. Tap Allow so the guide can hear you
mic.dismissed: Tap Start again, then choose Allow when your phone asks.
mic.unavailable: Your microphone is in use or missing. Close other apps using it (like a call), then tap Start again.

steps.ios-safari: Tap Reload page, then Start, and choose Allow. If Safari doesn't ask: tap aA in the address bar → Website Settings → Microphone → Allow, and reload. Still blocked? Check Settings → Apps → Safari → Microphone.
steps.ios-chrome: Tap Reload page, then Start, and choose Allow. If Chrome doesn't ask: open your iPhone's Settings → Apps → Chrome, turn Microphone on, and reload.
steps.ios-firefox: Tap Reload page, then Start, and choose Allow. If Firefox doesn't ask: open your iPhone's Settings → Apps → Firefox, turn Microphone on, and reload.
steps.android-chrome: The microphone is blocked for this page. Tap the icon left of the address, then Permissions → Microphone → Allow, and reload.
steps.android-firefox: The microphone is blocked for this page. Tap the lock icon left of the address → Microphone → Allow, and reload. Not there? Android Settings → Apps → Firefox → Permissions → Microphone → Allow.
steps.desktop-chrome: The microphone is blocked for this page. Click the icon left of the address, turn Microphone on, and reload.
steps.desktop-safari: Click Reload page, then Start, and choose Allow. If Safari doesn't ask: choose Safari → Settings for This Website… → Microphone → Allow, and reload.
steps.desktop-firefox: The microphone is blocked for this page. Click the crossed-out microphone in the address bar, clear the block, and reload.
steps.in-app: This app's built-in browser can't use the microphone. Copy the link and open it in Safari or Chrome.
steps.other: The microphone is blocked for this page. Allow it for this site in your browser's settings, then reload.

location_permissions.title: Enable Location Access
location_permissions.message: Share your location so we can guide you through nearby museums, galleries, and cultural sites as you explore.
location_permissions.disclaimer: You can change this setting anytime in your browser preferences.
